# Advanced crafting source-authoring verdict

**All 167 advanced recipes now have sufficient source-authoring directions to build their exact operational candidates.** The complete verdict resolves **AC-01–10, EN-01–10, RC-01–10, SC-01–10, TI-01–10 and TD-01–18**, with individual recipe mappings, complete body defaults, class-device eligibility and worked boundaries.

**This is source-authoring authority, not exact-card approval.** No advanced recipe, Tinker class card or pending feat is promoted. Current totals remain **520/687 recipes reviewed, 167 pending; public 333/433 reviewed, 100 pending**.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"}[Complete source-authoring verdict](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Advanced_167_Source_Authoring_Verdict.md) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="1"}[All-167 readable recipe register](sandbox:/mnt/data/ADVANCED_167_AUTHORING_REGISTER.md) · **:chatgpt-content-reference{index="2"}[Complete decision package, registers and verification evidence](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Advanced_167_Source_Authoring_Decisions.zip)**

The package includes the machine-readable 167-recipe register, all 48 current Tinker cards beside their individual interface dispositions, the 68-case index, all 18 automaton attacks, all 22 Scribing use mappings, and reproducible local verification scripts.

## 1. Inspection and preservation

I opened the supplied README and manifest, read all **167 complete originals and 758 component occurrences**, and inspected the current Tinker engine, all **48 complete class cards**, original class evidence, prepared cases and pending-feat comparisons. The relevant requested files were accessible.

| Independent inspection | Result |
|---|---:|
| Manifest payload byte/hash comparisons | **138 matched** |
| Complete advanced originals against the actual mechanical source and recorded indices | **167 matched** |
| Actual public-book paragraphs, including paragraphs inside tables | **600 matched**, comprising 100 six-paragraph bindings |
| Recorded cross-version comparisons | **4,340 classifications reproduced:** 4,115 equal, 225 different |
| Completed source/manifest/book/version checks | **5,248 passed** |
| New source-bound register, membership and fixed-arithmetic checks | **1,623 passed** |

The second check set covers every recipe, all 48 preserved class cards, all 68 case mappings, body dependencies and selected boundary arithmetic. The **19 worked sequence fixtures are authored expectations**, not automated runtime passes or authentication of campaign circumstances. Detailed results are included in the :chatgpt-content-reference{index="3"}[decision package](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Advanced_167_Source_Authoring_Decisions.zip).

All original source fields, absent/null distinctions, legacy names/effects, private metadata and historical versions remain unchanged. The confirmed gathering promotions and GEX corrections remain controlling; this verdict does not reopen them.

## 2. Shared decisions: all four trades

### Complete bodies, not material multiplication

**KEEP the ordered complete-body rule.** Before creation, reserve:

\[
\left\lfloor1.5Q\right\rfloor
\]

actual eligible complete mundane bodies, where \(Q\) is the source’s Standard output quantity. Fix one physical model and size for the batch before work. Printed ingredients, retained tools and the supplemental output bodies remain separate.

Every maximum-yield reserve must still be complete, functional, available and uncommitted elsewhere immediately before the roll—even when Standard would use fewer. Legal repair or replacement retains its original list position **before** the roll. There is no post-roll purchase, reordering or selection of the best surviving bodies.

The verdict supplies **22 physical defaults or size variants covering all 31 source trade/family bindings**. These include actual weapon/armor hosts, separate Rune plates, finite books and sheets, manual devices, two automaton chassis sizes, the command drone and siege ram. Their complete dimensions, mass, material defenses, primary constituents, handling and support requirements are in body catalogue **B** and the individual register.

### Four artisan credentials, but no ownership-based permissions

**KEEP** INT and the four actual artisan creation credentials: Enchanter’s tools, Runecarver’s tools, Calligrapher’s supplies and Tinker’s tools.

All **167 source `fieldCraftable` flags remain false**. A historical `timeMode:"field"` does not override that flag. Actual stationary facilities, source access mode, formula requirements, skill eligibility, tools, assistant limits, hours and triviality remain required.

Eligible **Forge Dwarf creation** receives its existing ×0.75 time adjustment, rounded upward once to a whole active minute, and its Standard-to-Exceptional benefit. This does **not** shorten research, encoding, Rune attunement, servicing, restoration or a genuine rest.

Buying a finished item grants no proficiency, formula, class level, spell access, Anacite module or control over another creature. Finished-item use has its own explicitly defined permissions.

### Creation quality and restoration

**KEEP six-band creation**, not the Core harvesting table or Salvaging’s binary exception. Structural quality retains the established noncompounding improvement, persistent flaw and latest damage deficit. It never increases charges, spell rank, damage, DC, command targets, service allowance or preparation potency.

**NEW explicit creature-output exception:** the **18 ordinary automata and recipe-686** retain their printed creature AC/HP. Structural quality does not increase those statistics. A singleton Flawed result uses the unsupported-flaw **Failed** fallback; multi-output Flawed results retain ordinary reduced yield. An admitted damaged chassis produces a proportionally damaged creature rather than receiving free healing.

Ordinary restoration requires the actual trained trade credential, compatible source worksite/tools and recoverable original primary structure:

| State | DC | Active work | Material reference |
|---|---|---|---|
| Functional, positive HP | 10 | `max(1 hour, recorded maximum HP ÷ 10 hours)` | 25% of the admitted mundane body reference |
| Broken/recoverable original wreck | Original recipe creation DC | `max(8 hours, recorded maximum HP ÷ 10 hours)` | 25% of the finished-unit reference |

Resolve restoration with Core task natural shifts collapsed to success/failure. **Repair restores HP and otherwise lawful function, not uses, charges, service, covenants or a fresh imprint.** Missing original inscriptions, destroyed primary mechanisms, consumed debris and terminal dismantling cannot be repaired by paying a quotation.

Finished reference remains:

\[
\frac{\text{source recommended batch value}}{\text{source Standard }Q}
+\text{actual admitted mundane body reference}.
\]

No regenerated labor price, quality-yield denominator, automatic buyer or reusable-tool capital charge is substituted.

### Inputs and catalysts

The exact totals remain **758 occurrences: 90 nonconsumed tool rows and 668 consumed rows, including six consumed-tool rows and 172 catalyst rows**.

The six consumed tools remain:

`recipe-637[1]`, `recipe-639[3]`, `recipe-673[3]`, `recipe-685[2]`, `recipe-686[2]`, `recipe-687[4]`.

Masterwork retains **one actual eligible catalyst unit total per batch**, not one per component row, output or charge. Returned material retains its identity, age, condition and actual containment.

The verdict explicitly defines source-unit failure-recovery precision for the relevant thread, ink, binding and preservation supplies. It does not turn a consumed lens, prepared crystal, hardware assembly or core into a fractional commodity merely because it is expensive. These decisions are fully mapped under **AC-04** and the per-recipe register.

## 3. Enchanting: EN-01–10

**Affected:** `recipe-121–159` and `recipe-636–639`.

All nine source families receive explicit bindings. Enchanted Weapon and Enchanted Armor transform an actual eligible weapon or armor suit. Wand, Staff, Charm, Sigil, Focus and Seal use their separately defined bodies. Generic Enchantment selects its admitted weapon, armor or charm host before work.

A Staff is not automatically a quarterstaff or spell focus. A Focus does not grant class component permissions. Command Sigil, Sentient Memory Seal and Winged Air Enchantment grant **no command authority, sentience or flight** through their titles.

### NEW concrete enhancement and charge profiles

Let **B** be the printed enhancement and **D** the exact source `damageType`.

| Host | Authoring decision |
|---|---|
| Weapon | B applies to its defined weapon accuracy and ordinary damage. **Charged Strike:** one Action, one legal attack with that actual weapon; spend one charge before rolling. On hit add **B d6 of D** to the same attack. It is not an Attack Action granting Extra Attack. |
| Armor suit | B enters the existing selected-suit defense-enhancement comparison. **Typed Guard:** Reaction and one charge against a matching positive incoming D component; reduce it by **B d6**, after applicable defenses but before HP loss and positive-damage-taken triggers. |
| Other admitted carrier | **Typed Pulse:** Action, one manipulating hand, one perceived compatible target within 30 feet and line of effect; fixed attack **+(4+B)**; hit **2B d6 of D**. No extra user ability/PB, splash or condition. |

These magnitudes and procedures are **NEW**, not recovered printed numbers. Normal attack criticals double attack dice, not flat modifiers. Typed Guard is not an attack, healing or a stored shield pool.

**KEEP exact types.** Water’s source cold damage does not create water; Vitality’s radiant damage does not heal; Stealth/Psychic does not confer invisibility or telepathy; Strength does not increase STR.

The EN effects are **nonspell magical item effects**. They do not receive an invented spell rank, ordinary spell RP/cadence, or a Counterspell window simply because they are magical. Actual applicable defenses still operate. A legally committed charge remains spent on a miss, prevention, immunity, interruption or later target loss.

### Dawn and coexistence

**NEW scoped adoption:** use the established campaign **06:00 dawn event**, once per item per day, restoring to the printed maximum rather than adding that amount. Current physical and suppression eligibility is checked at that event. A suppressed item misses that refill; later unsuppression does not catch it up. Travel, another local sunrise, sale and repair create no additional dawn.

Runes, scripts and Tinker service budgets do not inherit that event.

**KEEP the negative-grade guard.** A Crude selected suit’s −1 and an eligible EN +1 compare as +1, not −1+1=0. Suppression reveals the underlying −1 rather than a phantom zero. A second recipe imprint on the same host is not admitted; independently eligible equipment and class effects keep their own scopes.

## 4. Rune Carving: RC-01–10

**Affected:** `recipe-396–432` and `recipe-664–667`.

The five ordinary families use a separate **2-gp, 1-lb, B5/AC19 inscription plate**. Custom 667 uses its own **10-gp, 10-lb, B10/AC17 stationary stone seal**. Attaching a plate to armor, a door or a floor does not merge their bodies or HP.

### Charges, entry and ordinary effects

**Rune charges do not recharge.** There is no dawn, rest, repair, transfer or generic re-inscription reset.

Ground placement, arming, delay, actual entry, simultaneous entrants, disarming and rearming are explicit. Movement disarms a triggered plate; continuous occupancy is not repeated entry. Multiple printed charges require real later rearming and eligible events, not an automatic barrage.

**Binding:** retain each source STR save/DC and one-minute maximum. **NEW** bounded repeat-save/Action-escape routes apply. Moving the target wholly out of the local bound square, or moving/suppressing the required original plate, ends that particular restraint. No unprinted Stun or extra target is added.

**Explosive:** preserve the printed dice/type/DC and ten-foot radius. A successful save deals **zero**, not half. One charge pays for the burst; allies and the setter are not automatically excluded. No collateral-object damage or added condition is inferred.

**Healing:** preserve the printed healing. Register up to six actual allied identities; ordinary healing eligibility and consent still matter. A living dying ally can qualify; a Dead creature or destroyed crafted machine cannot. The separately defined deliberate touch activation does not become a moving healing aura.

### Warding

**NEW narrow attunement:** one actual bearer, one attuned Rune ward, ten active minutes, no automatic class or general attunement grant.

Activation costs the bearer’s **Reaction and one charge before the triggering attack/save roll**. It can protect that original event and remains until the marked next regular-start boundary. Extra turns do not reset the Reaction or expiry.

Ward AC and saves enter their explicitly named existing enhancement families. Two eligible values are not added merely because they came from different trades.

### Precise source-name treatment

**KEEP both histories.**

Current working-tool requirements for **396–416** say `Resonance lens`; their historical counterparts and the generic trade reference say `Focusing crystal`.

The eight consumed-component correspondences are:

**399[1], 400[0], 401[1], 403[1], 407[0], 409[0], 413[1], 415[0]**.

Their current `Resonance Lens` names and historical `Focusing Crystal` names remain preserved with unchanged IDs, quantities, tiers, values, mass and consumption.

**NEW limited binding:** the 21 working-tool requirements can use the defined physically appropriate ordinary Runecarver optic. For the eight ingredients, accept only the expressly recorded historical-name alias **on that exact matching source identity**. An ordinary working optic is not the consumed ingredient. The other ten consumed Focusing Crystal occurrences receive no propagated alias.

### Custom 667

Preserve its **one hour, 20 feet, DC28 CHA**, printed target labels, restrictions and missing charge field.

**NEW:** one lifetime activation, stored separately from the source schema. The stationary field tests an eligible creature’s actual teleport/incorporeal-movement attempt once per whole attempt—not every five-foot increment. Failure blocks that attempt with committed costs retained; success permits only that otherwise legal attempt. It supplies no repeated standing save, ordinary movement prohibition, general dispel or new classification of “extraplanar.”

Actual target classification and teleport/incorporeal effect records remain execution prerequisites. Literal Matrical/Matrix language remains uninterpreted.

## 5. Scribing: SC-01–10

**Affected:** `recipe-471–506` and `recipe-672–675`.

All nine families receive actual finite Book, journal, paper or parchment bindings. A Formula title does not manufacture ink; a Map does not create factual geography; a Codex does not become hundreds of independently charged pages.

### All 22 use questions resolved

**NEW use meaning:** the numeric `uses` value counts lifetime **legally committed cast starts by that physical carrier**, not readings, researchers, stored spells or daily charges.

| Use count | Exact recipes |
|---|---|
| **One use — 19 scripts** | 471, 473–475, 480–484, 487–492, 495, 496, 499, 501 |
| **Two uses — three scripts** | **502, 504, 505** |

Each still stores **one** actual payload. Two uses do not mean two different spells. A countered or otherwise unsuccessful legally committed cast spends its use. The body and ordinary text may survive, but copying, repair, erasure, transfer and re-encoding do not replenish casting.

### NEW encoding and the explicit spell-use exception

A script is created as a **blank, loadable magical carrier**. Loading requires authentic, legitimate, complete operational spell/ritual text with its exact class placement, rank and source version.

Encoding requires trained Calligrapher’s supplies, INT, the actual desk/tools, **`max(1, rank)` active hours**, the same number of silver pieces and **0.01 lb per hour** of defined supplies, and a **DC10+rank** Core task collapsed to success/failure. It supplies no spell cast, XP or Forge Dwarf reduction.

The named **`script-temporary-repertoire`** rule is an explicit **NEW addition to the ordinary repertoire gate**: the loaded script can supply its one stored spell as the repertoire/prepared choice **for that activation only**.

It does **not** waive class/list placement, minimum class level/rank, current RP, components, actions, concentration, reading, targeting or casting restrictions. A noncaster cannot use an eighth-rank script by rolling a generic use-magic-device check. Actual RP, Dissonance and Refrain apply once using the stored spell’s real identity. An unfinished spell record cannot be loaded by treating missing rank/effect fields as zero.

### References, rerolls and language

Research/Engineering/navigation benefits require actual relevant content and genuine consultation. Fictional or outdated information supplies no missing truth. Multiple books and assistants do not multiply equipment bonuses or PB.

The eleven map/diagram rerolls belong to the **physical item and formal expedition identity**. Spend after the related failure but before its consequences commit; reroll the original die selection and accept the replacement. Another holder or brief Haven stop does not reset the item. Equipment reroll chaining cannot repeatedly reroll the same check.

**Preserve `languages:0` on 476, 486 and 672.**

The supplied governors lack a complete Language Insight spending procedure. **NEW completion:** a per-researcher, per-language ledger capped at six unspent points; authentic useful evidence grants its stated points once per researcher across copies and remade editions. Spend three Insight plus eight active study hours to translate one supported preregistered passage of at most 250 words. This grants neither general fluency nor unknown meaning.

### Customs 674 and 675

**674:** three Language Insight toward one actual ancient language; +3 only on genuinely cross-disciplinary research involving at least two printed disciplines. Its finite study procedure reveals supported correspondences, not absent lore or operational Matrix metadata.

**675:** one lifetime bargain, two to six capable willing signatories, at most three objective clauses, and a maximum 30-day term. The **NEW one-mile enforcement scope** operates within the same established campaign world, without granting surveillance or planar reach. Each signatory has at most one proven voluntary breach event: **6d10 psychic and the printed 30-day visible mark**. Ambiguous, coerced or impossible bargains fail admission. Repeated breaches, repairs and multiple clauses do not repeatedly damage the same signer.

The mark is not generic Marked, tracking, compelled behavior or a source of penalties. The high-level annotation gate is explicitly completed, but it reveals only an actual provided authorized annotation—not invented cosmology.

## 6. Tinkering and the 18 class-device interfaces

**Affected:** `recipe-585–623` and `recipe-684–687`.

The sources contain **11 traps, 18 ordinary automata, 12 utilities, command drone 686 and siege device 687**. Their seven source families retain their identities; ram 687 is a specific Device-family body exception, not an invented eighth source family.

### Traps and all 18 automaton attacks

Traps retain each printed die/type/DC. **NEW** placement, arming delay, visible physical body, actual-entry trigger, successful-save-zero result, manual rearming and finite owner-offense accounting prevent placement-under-target or repeated-occupancy discharges. No class bomb riders or ally exclusions are inherited.

All 18 ordinary automata receive individually register
